name: Fiona MacLeod
bio:
Fiona's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, fueled by a childhood fascination with disassembling and reassembling radios. After earning a degree in Electrical Engineering from the University of Edinburgh, she initially worked in the aerospace industry, honing her skills in precision electronics and problem-solving. However, the allure of speed and innovation drew her to motorsport. 

She thrives on the dynamic challenges presented by racing, particularly the real-time diagnostics and rapid adjustments required in the pit lane. Fiona's approach is characterized by meticulous attention to detail and a knack for identifying subtle electrical anomalies that can impact performance. Her lone wolf nature allows her to focus intensely on the task at hand, making her a valuable asset in high-pressure situations. She enjoys working independently, but will readily provide insight to others when asked.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Fiona has a slender build and a focused, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even outside the garage.
Has a habit of humming quietly while soldering or diagnosing complex circuits.
Drinks copious amounts of strong Earl Grey tea.
